capabilities: create a group and generate an invitation code as admin
join an existing group by pasting an invitation code
record community activities in a shared registry
sync records bidirectionally with Supabase on a 1-10 minute interval or manually
keep each group's data isolated in its own dataset
extras: README is in Spanish. The Supabase backend is pre-configured by the author, so users need no Supabase setup, but all group data passes through that hosted service and accounts are required.
problem: Obsidian is a local, single-user app, so it offers no built-in way for a community group to keep one shared, synchronized activity record.
summary: Shared activity registry for Bahá'í groups: an admin creates a group, members join with an invite code, and records sync through Supabase.
